result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make **empathy a condition of power**.

Anyone empowered to make decisions for others would have to understand the consequences of those decisions—not reduce people to statistics, slogans, or disposable costs. I’d make that a requirement of authority, not merely a pleasant ideal.

Indifference shouldn’t be allowed to decide anyone else’s life.
